blockingIssues.description: `cli-count-stream` currently covers only multi-file scenarios and does not include the single-file filename-prefix scenario required by VAL-CLI-002.
`cli-count-stream` does not include stdin/stream scenarios, so VAL-CLI-001 and VAL-CLI-003 stream requirements are not fully validated by run_matrix artifacts alone.
`scripts/parity/validate_outputs.py` still unconditionally requires `.stderr.diff` artifacts across schemas, conflicting with the documented schema-v2-only stderr enforcement contract.
